_comment: Empirically discovered offset facts for Pokemon Recharged Yellow (v1.9.7),
produced by the ram-parser agent from the research/dumps/newgame-spam/ dump set.
Loaded by parse_ram.py on top of its built-in vanilla pokeemerald defaults;
research/hack-offsets.json (ROM-disassembly derived, owned by the hack-offsets
agent) is loaded after this file and wins on conflict -- it agrees with every
entry here (money 0x29C, SB2 early fields, storage vanilla).
History: an earlier revision hypothesized a follower Pokemon at SB1+0x238 and
vanilla-order bag offsets after money; hack-offsets.json disproved those (party
is at SB1+0x44, mapView moved to SB1+0x2510; bag pockets start at 0x374 with
new capacities), so they were removed. SB1+0x8AA/0x8AC is the trainer-rematch
(Match Call) system, not a mon slot.

sb1.money.evidence: u32 3000 (new-game money) constant at SB1+0x29C across all in-game newgame-spam dumps; vanilla 0x490 reads 0. Independently confirmed by hack-offsets.json disassembly of AddMoney/IsEnoughMoney.

sb2.playerName.evidence: decodes to entered name 'A' in f004200

sb2.playerTrainerId.evidence: stable TID/SID across dumps of one session

sb2.playTime.evidence: monotonic 8s..267s across f003000..f019800 matching frame counts

sb2.options.evidence: plausible options bits; hack may use extra high bits

sb1.registeredTexts.evidence: Union Room default phrases (HELLO/POKeMON/TRADE/BATTLE/...) decode at SB1+0x21B8, stride 21, 10 rows. Not used by the parser; recorded as a layout landmark.

storage.evidence: PokemonStorage fully vanilla: currentBox=0, all 14 box names Box1..Box14 decode at +0x8344, wallpapers cycle 0-3 at +0x83C2.
